title: Understanding Solar Panel Degradation Rate for American Homeowners
excerpt: Learn about the rate at which solar panels lose efficiency over time and how to maximize their lifespan.
content:
What is Solar Panel Degradation?

Solar panel degradation refers to the gradual loss of efficiency in solar panels over time, typically resulting from exposure to environmental factors.

Factors Affecting Degradation Rate

Several factors contribute to the degradation rate of solar panels, including temperature, humidity, and dirt accumulation.

Typical Degradation Rate

According to the National Renewable Energy Laboratory (NREL), the average degradation rate for solar panels is around 0.5% per year, with some high-quality panels losing as little as 0.3% per year.

Maximizing Lifespan

Regular cleaning, proper installation, and using high-quality panels can help minimize degradation and maximize the lifespan of your solar panels.

Conclusion

Understanding the solar panel degradation rate can help you make informed decisions when investing in solar energy for your home.
